Great Northern W.O.W. (Women on Wheels) Road Ride

Fargo, ND · Downtown · Road

Great Northern W.O.W. (Women on Wheels) Road Ride is a road group ride in Fargo, ND. It rolls every Thursday at 6:00 pm from Great Northern Bicycle Co.. About 20–25 miles, 15–18 mph. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15–18 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @gnbcfargo the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Great Northern W.O.W. (Women on Wheels) Road Ride group ride

A women-only road ride from the downtown shop. 20 to 25 miles at 15–18 mph, no-drop, with the emphasis on spinning and talking. Road bike recommended, helmet required. The shop also runs a Tuesday social ride and a Wednesday fitness ride at 6 pm.
